title: Long-Distance Touchpoint Gap by Person
dataSources: Shared calendar events (`sharedcalendar:event`), gift budget items (`giftbudget:item`), touchpoint logs (`touchpoint:log`), and relationship rituals (`relationship:ritual`).
app: Relationship and togetherness telemetry from shared calendars, gift budgets, message and call logs, and long-distance touchpoint trackers sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=touchpoint:log
| stats latest(_time) as last_seen count as events by person_name
| eval days_since=round((now()-last_seen)/86400,1)
| sort - days_since
description: Shows which peoples have gone quiet for long-distance touchpoints.
value: A gap view keeps meaningful contact from becoming something everyone assumes someone else handled.
implementation: Send long-distance touchpoints events to `index=personal` and alert when the gap since the last event grows beyond the expected cadence.
visualization: Table of peoples with time since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It totals which peoples have gone quiet longer than they should for long-distance touchpoints.
